title: DDI-BurdenMap: drug-level concentration of drug-drug interaction burden across pharmacokinetic mechanisms and medication exposure
description: Reproducibility code, public-facing documentation, aggregate outputs, and reconstruction scripts for DDI-BurdenMap. The study tests whether drug-drug interaction burden is concentrated at the drug level, persists within pharmacokinetic mechanism strata, independently replicates in DDInter, and remains overrepresented in observed medication pairings after the drug ranking is frozen. The submission reproducibility archive is the version of record for the exact redistributable fixed inputs and outputs. Third-party source datasets are not re-hosted when redistribution is constrained or unnecessary.
